This massive Lynel bow sports a bowstring made from a metal so tough, mere Hylians have trouble drawing it back.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|'''Mighty Lynel Bow'''|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 44 |durability = 35 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = false |throw = |distance = 20 |multiplier = |zoom = |reflect = |bash = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Mighty Lynel Bow}} Mighty Lynel Bows are [[Bow]]s wielded by [[Blue-Maned Lynel]]s within [[Hyrule]]. In [[Master Mode]], though, [[White-Maned Lynel]]s use Mighty Lynel Bows instead of their Blue-Maned counterparts. They will become rare as [[Enemy|Enemies]] tier up, but the Blue-Maned Lynel in the [[First Gatehouse]] of [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]] will always remain the same. Therefore, it can become the only source of Mighty Lynel Bows later in the game. Mighty Lynel Bows are a type of [[Lynel Gear]], a series of [[Weapon]]s that are created by [[Lynel]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} The bowstrings of Mighty Lynel Bows are noted to be made of a metal so tough that regular [[Hylian]]s have trouble drawing them. When they are drawn, however, they can fire three arrows at once. Since they are made of metal, they conduct [[Electricity]] and will attract [[Lightning]] if equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s. Mighty Lynel Bows also sink if they are dropped in water, but can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]].
